scope: Minimal general OQA/OES/OPE contracts and one source-scale metadata repair

changes.behavior: Prefer explicit interval movements in a rollforward; preserve interval boundaries; never sum successive end balances as issuances. Explicit sum/average of balances and distinct period flows remain allowed.
Preserve local footnote/section/row scope, do not add Total, distinguish whole balance from included component and avoid double counting. Unresolved ambiguity stays for OES; no added OQA fields.

Distinguish percentage-point differences from relative ratio growth. Symmetric gaps may use magnitude; explicit subtraction, temporal changes and signed bases keep direction. No automatic contra-asset abs.

DirectRetrieval returns the single reported scalar and its reported sign/magnitude; only explicitly requested, source-supported display conversion is permitted. No controller rewrites or answer-based corrections.

Explicit observed_meta.scale null/unknown overrides requested display scale as unknown; source printed value remains unchanged. Dollar symbols do not establish ones. Known thousand-to-million and known ones-to-million conversions remain allowed; source_scale_resolution records requested/observed/effective scales.
Keep both operands issuer/entity, instrument/tranche, time and rate-coverage scope; dimension compatibility alone does not license applying one note rate to all debt.

validation.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_refusal_repairs_r22.py tests/test_refusal_repairs_r21.py tests/test_engine.py tests/test_live_protocol_regressions.py tests/test_paper_repairs.py tests/test_evidence_alignment.py
validation.kind: Offline scripted protocol/dataflow/execution regressions; NOT fresh-API semantic accuracy verification

compatibility: Legacy OES records without observed_meta retain their old fallback metadata.
With explicit observed_meta, unknown source scale is no longer filled by the requested display preference. Some formerly asserted conversions therefore remain unknown.
The paper prompts remain byte-identical; supplemental static contracts instantiate allowed local conventions.
Prompt compliance and end-to-end accuracy require the parent real-API retest; scripted tests do not prove model accuracy.
excluded: No API calls or additional judge/retry.
No automatic sign/absolute-value change, scorer edit or gold modification.
No special coefficient or exception for AWK/ETR or another individual benchmark answer.
No old run, snapshot, source data or label was modified.
